name: Hard offset shadow
summary: A solid copy of a letter or a box, set behind it and moved down and to the side, with no blur.
how: Move the shadow 4 to 8 px down and to the right, or 5% to 10% of the letter height.
Fill the shadow with one solid colour, usually black.
Use no blur and no transparency.

origin.note: London type founders cast shaded and shadowed display letters for posters and handbills.

adoptions.via: Neo-brutalist interfaces give each card and button a solid black shadow offset by 4 to 8 px.

sources.title: Rob Roy Kelly, American Wood Type 1828-1900 (1969)
